summary: aap provider arguments: host (AAP_HOST), insecure_skip_verify (AAP_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY), password (AAP_PASSWORD, ignored if token set), timeout (default 5, 0 = none, AAP_TIMEOUT), token (AAP_TOKEN) and username (AAP_USERNAME). Avoid hardcoded credentials; expressions may only use values known before apply.
questions: What arguments does the Terraform aap provider accept?
Which environment variables configure the Terraform aap provider?
How do I skip TLS verification in the aap provider?
What is the default timeout for the aap provider?

answer_card.title: Terraform aap provider arguments
answer_card.answer_md:
| Argument | Env var | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | `AAP_HOST` | AAP server URL |
| `token` | `AAP_TOKEN` | preferred auth |
| `username` / `password` | `AAP_USERNAME` / `AAP_PASSWORD` | ignored if token set |
| `insecure_skip_verify` | `AAP_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | skip TLS checks |
| `timeout` | `AAP_TIMEOUT` | default 5; 0 = no timeout |

Don't hardcode credentials in .tf files.
